body:
The rework audit found real text reordering in Regnskapsloven §6-2: EGENKAPITAL OG GJELD moved below the list it introduces. Ordered paragraph blocks now preserve that source sequence without splitting a legal paragraph, and affected list subtrees render readable nested lists with the original markers. Structured regulation change/repeal/add/move targets now retain their document identity. Snapshots that need ordered content declare a version-3 content/formatter contract; legacy snapshots remain readable.

The reader changes add a project 404 page with current-source, archived-source and stored-copy recovery links, contain mobile comparison controls and scrolling, and clear stale results when selections become invalid. A catalog of 26 observed legacy commit identities pins comparisons and excludes orphan v2000 and future-year labels. The site describes these as unverified reconstructions rather than authoritative year-end legal states; existing branches and tags are preserved.

Validation: 223 integrated checks passed. Nine unaffected real-source samples remain byte-identical; Regnskapsloven source/model order and rendered list hierarchy were checked. Mobile comparison and 404 output were rendered and visually inspected at 390px. All catalog refs and representative pinned raw content were read back from GitHub. Production publication and reader verification remain after merge.

Related: #3, #4, #5, #6, #7, #9, #10 and sondreskarsten/norwegian-laws-history#1. This does not complete historical reconstruction or the search-size work.
title: Preserve ordered legal text and repair recovery and history comparisons
